# Mompy v0.1.6

This release consolidates the current classroom experience and delivers a production-ready Windows package under the Hepter Studios identity.

## Highlights

- Expands Lesson 1 into a structured, concept-first introduction to Python, strings, `print()` and execution order.
- Adds the classroom's secondary monitor sequences, visual demonstrations and Mompy's refined speaking animation.
- Keeps long code demonstrations readable: completed lines scroll naturally and the active execution line is automatically brought into view.
- Makes the Python use-case demonstrations consistent: code appears promptly and **Continue** remains visible in its own footer while the demo runs.
- Adds guided review when a learner misses a question, returning to the relevant explanation before resuming the lesson.
- Includes the initial Mompy English voice groundwork without enabling full voice coverage yet.
- Ships a refreshed Hepter Studios Windows installer with stable update/uninstall identity and embedded product metadata.

## Windows downloads

- `MompySetup-v0.1.6.exe` — recommended installer for Windows 10/11 (x64).
- `Mompy-windows-x64.zip` — portable build.

## Verification

The release passed the complete automated test suite, portable executable check, clean installation, in-place update, installed-app check and uninstall smoke test.

> The Windows binaries are currently unsigned. Windows may therefore display an unknown-publisher warning even though the executable metadata identifies Hepter Studios.
